title: 3dReHo
description: 3dReHo calculates Kendall's W per voxel using neighborhood voxels from 4D time series data set.

nneigh.description: Number of voxels in neighborhood, inclusive; can be 7 (for facewise neighbors), 19 (for face- and edge-wise neighbors), 27 (for face-, edge-, and node-wise neighbors). Default is 27.
nneigh.title: Neighborhood Voxel Count

chi_sq.description: Switch to output Friedman chi-square value per voxel as a subbrick.
chi_sq.title: Friedman Chi-Square Output Flag

mask.description: Include a whole brain mask within which to calculate ReHo. Otherwise, data should be masked already.
mask.title: Mask File

neigh_rad.description: Radius R of a desired neighborhood for voxelwise control, must be a floating point number >1. Examples: R=2.0 -> V=33, R=2.3 -> V=57, etc.
neigh_rad.title: Neighborhood Radius

neigh_x.description: Semi-radius length A for ellipsoidal neighborhood.
neigh_x.title: Neighborhood Semi-radius X

neigh_y.description: Semi-radius length B for ellipsoidal neighborhood.
neigh_y.title: Neighborhood Semi-radius Y

neigh_z.description: Semi-radius length C for ellipsoidal neighborhood.
neigh_z.title: Neighborhood Semi-radius Z

box_rad.description: Cubic box radius BR centered on a given voxel for neighborhood control. Examples: BR=1 -> V=27, BR=2 -> V=125, etc.
box_rad.title: Cubic Box Radius

box_x.description: Box volume neighborhood dimension X. Values put in get added in the +/- directions of each axis.
box_x.title: Box Volume X

box_y.description: Box volume neighborhood dimension Y. Values put in get added in the +/- directions of each axis.
box_y.title: Box Volume Y

box_z.description: Box volume neighborhood dimension Z. Values put in get added in the +/- directions of each axis.
box_z.title: Box Volume Z

in_rois.description: Input a set of ROIs, each labeled with distinct integers. ReHo will be calculated per ROI.
in_rois.title: ROIs Input File
